variants.user_notes: Programming through the USB bootloader needs the board in its bootloader (DFU) mode; on many boards, hold its button while plugging it in.

ai_hints: Wired to the FPGA's RGB LED driver pads: red RGB2, green RGB0, blue RGB1.
Drive it through SB_RGBA_DRV, the iCE40 UltraPlus's RGB LED driver cell (sink only).
